name: Fisher & Paykel
legalEntityNote: Fisher & Paykel Appliances Limited is the principal appliance operating company and has been Haier-owned since 2012. Regional entities can handle sales, imports and warranty obligations; in the United States, official warranty information identifies Fisher & Paykel Appliances, Inc. as warrantor. DCS is a separately marketed cooking brand owned by Fisher & Paykel.
headline: Fisher & Paykel: New Zealand appliance design within Haier
description: Fisher & Paykel Appliances is a New Zealand-founded premium appliance business within Haier Smart Home. Haier acquired it in 2012. Its range spans cooking, refrigeration, DishDrawer dishwashers and laundry, with design and engineering in New Zealand and manufacturing across several countries.
metaDescription: Who owns Fisher & Paykel? See its Haier relationship, New Zealand origins, appliance manufacturing, CEO and new Auckland innovation campus.
disclaimer: World Clean Biz is an independent industry publication and is not affiliated with Fisher & Paykel or Haier. Parent ownership, the Fisher & Paykel and DCS brands, regional entities, factories, suppliers, importers and warranty providers are separate layers and should not be generalized.

ownership.summary: Fisher & Paykel Appliances Limited is a New Zealand-rooted premium appliance company acquired by Haier in 2012 and reported within Haier's global home-appliance portfolio. Fisher & Paykel continues as a distinct brand and operating business; Haier Group, Haier Smart Home, Fisher & Paykel Appliances Limited, regional subsidiaries and the separately marketed DCS brand are related but not interchangeable.
ownership.parentCompany: Haier Smart Home Co., Ltd., within Haier Group
ownership.displayLabel: Haier Smart Home subsidiary; New Zealand-founded appliance business

leadership.name: Daniel Witten-Hannah
leadership.role: Chief Executive Officer, Fisher & Paykel Appliances
leadership.context: Identified as CEO in the company’s 30 July 2026 Auckland campus announcement.

productPortfolio.name: Premium cooking appliances
productPortfolio.positioning: Built-in ovens, cooktops, ranges and ventilation emphasize integrated kitchen design and premium materials.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Verify dimensions, fuel, voltage, ventilation, installation certification and local service capacity by model.

productPortfolio.name: Refrigeration and dishwashing
productPortfolio.positioning: Integrated refrigeration and DishDrawer dishwashers are distinctive parts of the Fisher & Paykel design system.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Cabinet specifications, water connections, panels, accessories, energy labels and spare parts require market-specific checks.

productPortfolio.name: Laundry appliances
productPortfolio.positioning: Washers and dryers extend the brand's coordinated whole-home offer in selected markets.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Range availability, capacity, origin, voltage and warranty vary by country and product generation.

productPortfolio.name: DCS outdoor cooking
productPortfolio.positioning: DCS is an owned but separately marketed professional-style outdoor cooking brand.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Distribution or trademark authorization for Fisher & Paykel should not be assumed to include DCS.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Haier's official Fisher & Paykel profile reports manufacturing operations in Thailand, China, Italy and Mexico.
manufacturingSupplyChain.scope: Haier brand-profile disclosure reviewed September 2026; individual models may move between plants
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Match the exact product, model, factory and country-of-origin record rather than assuming one location serves the full range.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Fisher & Paykel's supply-chain statement says products can be manufactured by group operations or by suppliers on the group's behalf.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Identify the legal manufacturer, physical factory, critical suppliers, audit rights and engineering-change controls for each SKU.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: The company's history reflects a New Zealand origin, while current production is an international network.
manufacturingSupplyChain.scope: Historical identity versus current model origin
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Do not use brand heritage as an origin claim; rely on the rating plate, customs and supplier documentation.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: The July 2026 Auckland campus announcement brings research, engineering, design and testing together in New Zealand as part of Haier Smart Home’s innovation network. The company says teams are moving in ahead of an official October 2026 opening.
manufacturingSupplyChain.scope: Design and innovation facilities; not a finished-appliance production plant
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Separate product-development location from the factory and country of origin on the exact model.

marketsChannels.evidence: Fisher & Paykel operates regional websites and sells through premium appliance dealers, kitchen designers, architects, builders and selected direct channels.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Confirm dealer authorization, project territory, display obligations, installation scope and after-sales coverage.

marketsChannels.evidence: Regional Fisher & Paykel entities can carry local sales, import and warranty responsibilities.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Retain the quotation, invoice, importer label, compliance declaration and warranty naming each responsible entity.

marketsChannels.evidence: The U.S. warranty identifies Fisher & Paykel Appliances, Inc. as warrantor for covered North American products.
marketsChannels.scope: United States and applicable North American warranty terms
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Do not extend the U.S. warrantor or coverage period to another market without its local terms.

competitivePosition.summary: World Clean Biz assessment: Fisher & Paykel competes through integrated premium design, distinctive products such as DishDrawer and a specialist dealer and design channel. Haier ownership adds scale without eliminating the brand's separate operating identity. Buyers should focus on regional entity, factory, origin, installer and warranty evidence rather than relying on New Zealand heritage or parent ownership alone.

developments.title: Auckland headquarters and innovation campus announced
developments.summary: Fisher & Paykel announced a new global headquarters and innovation campus serving its appliance business and Haier Australasia. Teams are moving in; the formal opening is scheduled for October 2026.

developments.title: Fisher & Paykel joins Haier
developments.summary: Haier completed its acquisition while Fisher & Paykel continued as a distinct appliance company and brand.

developments.title: Fisher & Paykel acquires DCS
developments.summary: The acquisition added a separately marketed outdoor-cooking brand to the appliance business.

developments.title: Fisher & Paykel is founded in New Zealand
developments.summary: The company's New Zealand heritage begins in 1934, distinct from the current international manufacturing footprint.
